Changes: packages/framework/package.json → @fugue/framework, apps/customer-summary/package.json → @fugue/customer-summary, root package.json → fugue. tasks.description: Create the @fugue/host package scaffolding with package.json, tsconfig.json, and implement the HostError discriminated union and Config schemas (Zod env schema for host config + fugue.yaml schema for per-DAG config)
tasks.plan_context: HostError DU with 15 kinds mapping to HTTP statuses. HostConfigSchema validates env vars (DAGS_REPO_URL, REDIS_URL, PORT, MAX_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY, etc). FugueYamlSchema validates per-DAG YAML (team, owner, env, maxConcurrent, timeoutMs, route, cacheTtlMs). All domain functions return Result — no thrown exceptions. Package depends on @fugue/framework, zod, hono, ioredis, yaml.

tasks.description: Implement the HostState discriminated union with pure transition functions and the immutable Registry type with snapshot builders (emptyRegistry, withDag, withoutDag, freeze)
tasks.plan_context: HostState DU: booting | syncing | ready | degraded | draining | stopped. Pure transitions: bootComplete, syncStarted, syncCompleted, syncFailed, beginDrain, drainComplete, redisDied, redisRecovered. Registry is ReadonlyMap<DagId, RegisteredDag> frozen per sync cycle. RegisteredDag contains id, team, route, dag (DagDef), inputSchema, config, loadedAt, sha, healthy, disabledReason. Key invariant: once frozen, never mutated — atomic reference swap on sync. Property tests for all valid transition sequences.

tasks.description: Implement the DagRegistration contract type and Zod validation schema that DAG authors export from dag.ts — wraps DagDef with inputSchema and optional meta
tasks.plan_context: DagRegistration interface: { dag: DagDef, inputSchema: z.ZodType<unknown>, meta?: { description?: string, version?: string } }. DagRegistrationSchema validates the export shape at runtime: dag must have id/nodes/edges, inputSchema must have parse method. inputSchema is mandatory — every DAG declares what input it accepts. Host validates incoming HTTP payloads against this. Defined in @fugue/host (not framework). Test: valid export, missing fields, invalid shapes, defaults applied.

tasks.description: Implement pure concurrency limiter state (global + per-DAG acquire/release with Result returns) and pure circuit breaker state machine (closed/open/half-open with deterministic clock injection)
tasks.plan_context: Concurrency: ConcurrencyState { global: {current, max}, perDag: Map<DagId, {current, max}> }. acquire returns Result<{state, token}, 'global-at-capacity' | 'dag-at-capacity'>. release decrements. Defaults: global 50, per-DAG 10. Circuit breaker: CircuitState = closed | open | half-open. recordSuccess/recordFailure/attemptReset/forceReset (called on new git version). Threshold: >5 failures in 60s → open. Injected clock for deterministic testing. Property test: acquire/release balance returns to zero.

tasks.description: Implement the git sync subsystem: GitPort interface + Bun.spawn adapter, module loader with dynamic import + DagRegistration validation, sync loop with poll timer + SHA comparison, and DAG diff detection between snapshots
tasks.plan_context: GitPort: clone, pull, currentSha, hasLockfileChanged — all return Result. Impl via Bun.spawn('git', [...]) with timeout + stderr capture. Dev mode: DAGS_LOCAL_PATH skips git, reads dir, hashes mtimes. Module loader: import(path + '?v=' + sha) for cache-busting, validate default export against DagRegistrationSchema, catch thrown errors → HostError. discoverDagPaths globs dags/*/*/dag.ts. Sync loop flow: wait interval → rev-parse → compare SHA → pull → check lockfile → bun install if changed → discover → load each → build new Registry → atomic swap → force-reset circuit breakers for new SHA DAGs. Error isolation: single DAG failure does NOT block others.

tasks.description: Implement the NodeContext factory that constructs per-request contexts with shared infrastructure (LLM client, tracer), per-request unique fields (runId, AbortSignal), and DAG-namespaced Redis key prefixes for cache and checkpoints
tasks.plan_context: SharedInfra: { llm: LlmClient, redis: Redis, tracer: Tracer, contentFilter: ContentFilter | null }. createNodeContextForDag(shared, dag, runId, signal) → NodeContext. Cache keys: fugue:{dagId}:cache:{key}. Checkpoint keys: fugue:{dagId}:{runId}:{nodeId}. runId is fresh UUID per request (or caller-supplied for resume). LLM client + tracer are shared singletons. Uses makeNodeContext from @fugue/framework. Test: key namespacing isolation between DAGs, shared infra reuse, per-request unique fields.

tasks.description: Implement the HTTP layer with Hono: router with all P1 routes, run-dag handler (sync execution with timeout), list-dags handler, health/readiness handlers, error-handler middleware mapping HostError/FrameworkError to HTTP status codes, concurrency-guard middleware, and typed response builders
tasks.plan_context: Hono routes: POST /dags/:id/run (sync), GET /dags (list), GET /health (always 200), GET /readiness (200 when redis + >=1 DAG, else 503). Request flow: concurrency-guard → lookup DAG → validate input → check circuit breaker → acquire token → create NodeContext → runDag with timeout → map Result to HTTP → record success/failure → release token. ErrorResponse shape: { error, message, details?, dagId?, runId? }. All HostError kinds mapped to status codes (404/400/408/429/503/500). Per-DAG timeout: configurable, max 120s, returns 408. 429 includes Retry-After header.

tasks.description: Implement the lifecycle orchestration: startup sequence (validate Redis, initial clone, load DAGs, mark ready), signal handlers, host.ts top-level wiring connecting all subsystems, index.ts entry point, and Dockerfile
tasks.plan_context: Startup: validate Redis connectivity (exit with error if unreachable), clone dags repo (or use DAGS_LOCAL_PATH), initial sync (discover + load all DAGs), validate all before marking ready, start HTTP server, start sync poll timer. host.ts is the top-level imperative shell wiring: SharedInfra construction, registry state management, sync loop kickoff, HTTP server bind. index.ts: parse config → construct host → boot. Dockerfile: FROM oven/bun:1.2-alpine, apk add git, DAGs cloned at runtime not baked in. Integration test: boot → sync → register → serve → respond.

tasks.description: Migrate apps/customer-summary to DagRegistration format: re-express as dag.ts default export with inputSchema, create fugue.yaml, configure custom /summarize route, and verify all existing integration tests pass unchanged through the host
tasks.plan_context: Migration: customer-summary re-expressed as DagRegistration { dag: createSummaryDag(), inputSchema: z.object({ customer_id: z.string().min(1), resume_run_id: z.string().optional() }), meta: { description, version } }. fugue.yaml: team cx, route /summarize (backwards-compat). Source injection via factory function pattern. Verify: all existing tests pass, MLflow traces identical, checkpointing/resume works. Host supports route override so migrated DAG keeps serving at /summarize. Integration test: dag-isolation (same cache key → isolated results).

tasks.description: Write ADRs 0030-0036 documenting architectural decisions: state machine with pure transitions, immutable registry snapshot, framework independence, DagRegistration as host contract, raw git via Bun.spawn, Hono HTTP server, layered error handling
tasks.plan_context: AD-1: Model host lifecycle as HostState DU with pure transition functions, side effects at adapter boundaries. Rejected: event-sourced, imperative controller. AD-2: Registry is immutable ReadonlyMap frozen per sync cycle, atomic reference swap. Rejected: mutable Map with locks. AD-3: @fugue/framework has zero imports from @fugue/host, remains standalone. AD-4: DagRegistration defined in @fugue/host, wraps DagDef with host metadata. Rejected: extending DagDef. AD-5: Git via Bun.spawn wrapped in GitAdapter port. Rejected: isomorphic-git, simple-git. AD-6: Hono for HTTP, consistent with existing app. AD-7: HostError DU for host concerns, FrameworkError passes through unchanged.

tasks.description: Write ADRs 0037-0043 documenting architectural decisions: pure concurrency limiter, pure circuit breaker, big-bang rename, single instance in-memory state, separate dags repository, config via Zod env + YAML, OTel tracing for host operations
tasks.plan_context: AD-8: Concurrency as pure counter state, acquire returns Result<Token, at-capacity>. Rejected: semaphore class, external rate limiter. AD-9: Circuit breaker as pure state machine (closed/open/half-open), time-based recovery via injected clock. Rejected: opossum library. AD-10: Big-bang rename @ai-summary → @fugue, no external consumers. AD-11: Single instance, all state in-memory, only async results in Redis. Rejected: Redis-backed state, multi-instance. AD-12: DAG code in separate git repo, cloned at startup. Rejected: DAGs in host monorepo, package registry. AD-13: Host config from Zod env vars, per-DAG config from fugue.yaml + Zod. AD-14: OTel instrumentation for host-level operations (sync, import, request lifecycle).
